about.zh: 整张图放大到约 400 万像素（小图 2 倍）轻轻重画，让手变大；再把每只手放大重画后贴回去：有 SAM3 模型时先按文字找出贴着手形的轮廓重画一遍，再用手部检测框补修一遍。
about.en: The whole picture is enlarged to about 4 megapixels (2× for a small one) and redrawn lightly, so the hands grow; then each hand is redrawn larger and pasted back: with the SAM3 model here, first inside the outline it finds by the word, then once more in the box the hand detector finds.

source.zh: 参考作者的「先放大重画」和「手部精修」两步合在一起，2026-10-29 在 RTX 4050 上试出这组数；SAM3 按文字找手那一轮照他的连法，2026-11-03 加入
source.en: The reference author's light redraw after enlarging and his hand detailing, put together; these numbers tried on an RTX 4050 on 2026-10-29; the SAM3 pass finding hands by the word follows his wiring, added on 2026-11-03

after: A fallback: a FLUX-Fill redraw of one square crop around each hand did better in the user's tests; use that when you have it. The picture is enlarged to about 4 megapixels (2× for one of about 1 megapixel, at most 2×, not at all for a large one) and drawn again lightly (the sampler now takes it, at denoise 0.4), then the hands are redrawn larger: with SAM3 here, first each hand it finds by the word inside its own outline (shaped_hands), then each hand the detector finds, in its box (hands, denoise 0.45), saved with prefix hands_fixed (without SAM3, which the user can get in the ways panel, only the detector's pass); the enlarged one is saved too, without the hand pass. About 3 tries in 4 gave a good hand in the pictures tried (one or two people, simple poses), no rate for crowds or hard poses: run_workflow with batch 4 (each try its own seed), then check them before the user does: zoom_image each hands_fixed picture on the hand, compare_with the enlarged one (the light redraw alone already changes faces and hands), and drop a hand with the wrong number of fingers, fused or melted fingers, one far bigger or smaller than its arm, a seam at its edge, or a hand that was fine made worse; say if a hand was missed. None good: run_workflow batch 4 again, at most twice. Then a picks panel zoomed on the hand lets the user choose among the good ones.
notes: Tried on the Codex test picture (1280×832, three characters, the hand about 110×78 px): the hand pass alone gave a good hand in about half the seeds whatever its size (512 or 768) and denoise (0.45 or 0.55); enlarging 1.5× first gave good hands in 3 of 4, 2× gave sharper fingers in the same seeds (about 105 s instead of 75 s). Denoise 0.4 for the enlarged redraw kept the layout; faces and splashes change a little. The SAM3 pass (2026-11-03): its word says how many it takes, "hand" alone only the likeliest hand, "hand:8" up to eight; on a 832×1216 picture of a girl waving both hands (enlarged 2×) it outlined both hands closely at threshold 0.5 (0.2 found no more), about 112 s with both passes on Anima with the Turbo LoRA. GPT's check the same day (two people, one hand with fused fingers, two seeds): SAM3 found both hands (one outline took in the wrist), both versions gave acceptable hands; on that one picture the SAM3 pass was not shown better than the detector alone.

runs.model: Anima (MiaoMiao Harem 1.5, Turbo LoRA, SAM3 pass)
